title: Childhood and Education of Swami Desikan
body:
Childhood and Education of Swami Desikan

As discussed previously, Swami Desikan was born in the year 1268 in the Tamil month of Puratasi, on the tenth day of the Shukla Paksha (Vijayadashami), under the nakshatram of Tiruonam, in the Thoopul agrahaaram, opposite the Deepaprakashar Temple, in Tiruttankaa. 


Upon birth, Swami Desikan was named Venkatanatha by his maternal uncle Kidambi Appullar. As Swami Desikan grew, his uncle became his guru. When Swami Desikan was just five years of age, he was taken by his maternal uncle, Kidambi Appular, to attend a discourse by Nadadhoor Ammal, a revered Sri Vaishnava Scholar at the time. As soon as Nadadhoor Ammal saw Venkatanatha, he saw a divine radiance in the child and stopped the lecture he was delivering to hug the child affectionately. 


After this, when Nadadhoor Ammal said that he had forgotten where he had stopped his lecture, Venkatanatha reminded him of the point at which he had stopped. This act astonished the crowd, as they had never seen a five-year-old boy comprehend the deep intricacies of the philosophical knowledge being discussed. It was then that Nadadhoor Ammal predicted and blessed Venkatanatha, saying he would become the torchbearer to spread Sri Vaishnavism everywhere. 


By the age of seven, Venkatanatha was initiated into Brahmacharya by Kidambi Appullar, who performed the Upanayanam and Panchasamskaram. Upon being initiated into the Brahmacharya ashramam, Venkatanatha was taught the Vedas as well as the Naalaiyira Divyaprabandham.
